  V=$(bash submit.sh /tmp/$f 2>/dev/null | grep -o 'vuln_exit=[0-9]*' )
  F=$(bash submit.sh /tmp/$f 2>/dev/null | grep -o 'fixed_exit=[0-9]*' )
  echo "$f: $V $F"
done
echo "=== special files ==="
for f in /dev/null /dev/zero ""; do

  F=$(bash submit.sh "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -o 'fixed_exit=[0-9]*')
  echo "f='$f': $V $F"
done"}}
